english.title: Serve on jury when not qualified to do so
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowing that you were not qualified for jury service by reason of section 40 of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994, served on a jury sitting in the case of **(..SPECIFY CASE..) at **(..SPECIFY COURT OR TRIBUNAL VENUE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 20(5)(e) of the Juries Act 1974.
